This <b>{{lc:{{PAGENAME}}}}</b> is an item that will be regularly awarded to the player each time they bury or cremate a [[corpse]], while pointedly not being awarded when the corpse is disposed of in the nearby river. Its only known purpose is to be sold to [[Horadric]], the innkeeper of [[The Dead Horse]], at a consistent price of {{Money|150}} each.
